description: Processing and understanding human language with AI

slides.title: Text Preprocessing
slides.content:
# Text Cleanup 🧼

Computers can't read messy text. We must prep it.

1. **Lowercasing**: "Apple" == "apple".
2. **Stopwords Removal**: Remove common useless words ("the", "is", "at").
3. **Stemming/Lemmatization**: Reduce words to root.
   - *Running, Ran, Runs* -> *Run*.
4. **Tokenization**: Splitting sentences into words list.

slides.title: Vectorization
slides.content:
# Words to Numbers 🔢

## Bag of Words (BoW)
Counts frequency of words. Simple but loses context.

## TF-IDF
**Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency**. Highlights unique words that are important to a specific document, ignoring generic words.

## Word Embeddings (Word2Vec)
Converts words to dense vectors. Captures meaning!
- *King - Man + Woman ≈ Queen*
- Words with similar meanings are close in vector space.

slides.title: Models and Apps
slides.content:
# NLP Models & Uses 🗣️

## Modern Models
- **RNN/LSTM**: Good for sequences.
- **Transformers (BERT, GPT)**: The revolution! Process entire sentences at once using "Attention Mechanisms".

## Applications
- Sentiment Analysis (Positive/Negative review?)
- Machine Translation (Google Translate)
- Chatbots (ChatGPT)
- Text Summarization
